scenes.label: Meet the team
scenes.title: The discovery club
scenes.caption: Meera and Kabir are making a poster for the discovery club. Their drawing is ready, but the draft also includes a home address. They ask who really needs that detail before putting the poster online.

scenes.label: The problem
scenes.title: A problem to solve
scenes.caption: A public post may reach people outside the class. A nickname does not hide a school badge, location or daily travel time. Several small clues together can reveal more than the writer intended to share.
scenes.speech: A public post may reach people outside the class. A nickname does not hide a school badge, location or daily travel time. Several small clues together can reveal more than the writer intended to share.

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.title: Try the idea
scenes.caption: The team separates the event title from contact details. A teacher can share a school contact through an approved channel. Before posting, they inspect the audience setting and the whole picture, including writing in the background.
scenes.speech: The team separates the event title from contact details. A teacher can share a school contact through an approved channel. Before posting, they inspect the audience setting and the whole picture, including writing in the background.

scenes.label: Your decision
scenes.title: Choose and explain
scenes.caption: The club needs to show its artwork. The home address and daily bus time are unrelated to that purpose. Compare the actions, then inspect the explanation before moving on.
scenes.speech: The club needs to show its artwork. The home address and daily bus time are unrelated to that purpose. Compare the actions, then inspect the explanation before moving on.
scenes.dialogue: Which version can go on the public club page?

scenes.label: What changes
scenes.title: See the consequence
scenes.caption: Show the artwork and club title; leave out the home address and travel details. The teacher checks the audience before publication.
scenes.speech: Show the artwork and club title; leave out the home address and travel details. The teacher checks the audience before publication.
scenes.dialogue: Match information to its intended audience.

scenes.label: Enter the lab
scenes.title: Your turn in the lab
scenes.caption: Now open the practice lab. Work through personal details, then audience choices, then a safer poster. Test each answer, read feedback and try again when needed. Save your evidence and explain one decision in your own words.
